about: every stylesheet and Svelte component Carnivore ships, each class filed under the style guide section that documents it. tests/test_style_guide_drift.py fails when the code and this file disagree. add a new class or component here, under the section that documents it, in the same change that adds it; python3 -m tests.helpers.style_guide_inventory prints the gap. a plugin that keeps its strings and guide entries in its own folder files its rows in web/src/cplugs/<id>/style-guide.json and its prose in web/src/cplugs/<id>/style-guide/<section file>.html instead (docs/cplugs.md 1.2a).

sections.title: principles and the military terminal look
brand: name, logos and background art
base: one scale, one component set, every theme
base components: card, fold, field, buttons, option list, tag, list, toolbar, state
toasts, notices, empty, loading and error states
operations center cells, frames and the grid
page shells, headers, drawers and sidebars
terminal chrome and the prompt bar
ledger, catalog, themes and blueprints screens
making a new icon or component that fits
when nothing in the guide fits
